## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Verification

- [ ] Backend lint and tests pass
- [ ] Frontend lint, typecheck, tests, and build pass
- [ ] Relevant E2E tests pass
- [ ] New calculations or behaviour have tests
- [ ] Synthetic/estimated/real data is labelled accurately
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, `.env` files, or patient data are included
- [ ] Documentation updated where behaviour, data, or assumptions changed

## Screenshots / notes

If this is a UI change, include desktop and mobile screenshots. If this changes a
method or metric, explain the impact on existing results.
